<sup>a</sup> ר' חוצפית המ'. Ex. R. s. 3, end; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְתוּרְגְּמָנִים, נִין</plural-form> … Koh. R. to VII, 5. Ib. to IX, 17. Pes. 50

<entry id="M03039">
<head-word>מָתַח</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to extend, stretch</italic> (cmp. משך, משח).</definition>
<notes> Kil. VI, 9 המוֹתֵחַ זמורה וכ' if one trains a vine from one tree to another. Sabb. 75
<sup>a</sup> המותח חוט וכ' he who pulls the thread of a seam (bringing the ends closer together), v. infra. Gen. R. s. 3, a. e. שלא תאמר מיכאל היה מותח וכ' lest you say, Michael stretched (the world) in the south &c., v. מָדַד; Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV מְמַתֵּחַ. Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>d</sup> top אדם מותח אהל וכ' when one stretches a tent-cover, in course of time it becomes loose; Gen. R. s. 12, end; Yalk. Is. 314.—Gen. R. s. 10, end, v. 
<italic>Nif.</italic>—[Yalk. Prov. 961 סופו להיות מותח v. מָתַק.]—Part. pass. מָתוּחַ; f. מְתוּחָה; 
<plural-form>pl. מְתוּחִים, מְתוּחִין; מְתוּחוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>stretched, extended</italic>; (of a bow) 
<italic>bent</italic>; trnsf. (of judgment) 
<italic>ready to be discharged, aimed.</italic> Kel. XXI, 3. Gen. R. s. 35 אותה מדת הדין שהיתה מ' כנגד … ומְתָחָהּ וכ' that very judgment which was aimed against Israel, did the Lord turn and aim against the Egyptians. Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>c</sup> top הדין מ' כנגד וכ' judgment is ready against the whole family. Pesik. R. s. 38; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מִיתֵּחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, esp. 
<italic>to straiten straps; to bring objects closer together</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. I, 8 אף מְמַתְּהִין you may also straigten (bed-straps). Ib. 10
<sup>a</sup> וממתחין שאם … מְמַתְּחוֹ ‘you may stretch’, means when it (a strap) is lax, you may straiten it; Y. ib. I, 80
<sup>d</sup> bot. Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 10 מחוסרין … למַתֵּחַ need … stretching. Midr. Till. l. c., v. supra.—Y. Sabb. XIII, beg. 14
<sup>a</sup> המְמַתֵּחַ צדדין (ed. Krot. הממחה צדדיו, corr. acc.) he who brings the ends of two pieces close together (by pulling the thread up and knotting it), v. supra; Y. Kil. IX, end, 32
<sup>d</sup> המְמַתֵּיחַ צדדין (or המַמְתִּיחַ 
<italic>Hif.</italic>; not צדדיו); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְתַּח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be stretched, spread, drawn</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 38
<sup>b</sup> נִמְתְּחוּ אבריו his limbs were stretched (shaped); (Ab. d’ R. N. ch. I נתקשרו); Yalk. Gen. 15. Ib. 16 היו נִמְתָּחִין והולכין (ib. also מוֹתְחִין; Gen. R. s. 10, end מותחין) they (the works of creation) continued to extend (develop). Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>c</sup> bot. יִמָּתֵחַ הרקיע (or יִמְתַּח) let the firmament be stretched out. R. Hash. 22
<sup>b</sup> יִמָּתֵחַ על העמוד shall be stretched on the pillory. Y. Hor. II, 46
<sup>d</sup> נִמְתְּחָה הקשת the bow was bent (euphem. for 
<italic>erection</italic>). Yalk. Ps. 796 נמתחה החרב the sword (of judgment) was drawn; (Tanḥ. B’midb. 7 נמשכה; ib. ed. Bub. 7 נשמטה).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְמַתֵּחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3 והיו הולכין ומִתְמַתְּחִין וכ' they would have gone on spreading &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>b</sup> מ' דר' אפס the college of R. E.—Ib. מ' דרקיעא the heavenly session (of the departed scholars). B. Mets. 86

<sup>b</sup>; a. fr. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the proceedings at college, subject of discussions</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 117

<senses>
<sense>

<notes> Y. Peah III, 17
<sup>d</sup> bot. איזו היא מ' … מ' וכ' what is a 
<italic>mattanah?</italic> All my property be given to—as a gift from now, contrad. to דִּיאֲתִיקִי. B. Bath. 147
<sup>a</sup> מניין למַתְּנַת שכיב וכ' how can it be proven that the donation of one expecting to die is legal by Biblical law (without formal possession)? Kidd. 6
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מ' ע"מ להחזיר שמה מ' a present made with the condition that it must be returned, is legally a present (the recipient’s property for the time being); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. מַתָּנוֹת</plural-form>. Ber. 5
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—מַתְּנוֹת כהונה, v. כְּהוּנָּה.—Tosef. Dem. II, 7 מ' גבולין the priestly privileges outside of the Temple. Ib. 8 יש לו במ' has a right to priestly gifts. Tosef. Peah II, 13 ארבע מ' בכרם there are four gifts for the poor connected with the vineyard; Ḥull. 131

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>sprinkling or smearing the blood</italic> (on the altar &c.).</definition>

<plural-form>Pl. as ab. Ib. V, 3 ארבע מ' על וכ'</plural-form> four applications (with the finger dipped in the blood) at the four corners. Ib. 4 שתי מ' שהן ארבע two sprinklings appearing like four, i.e. towards two opposite corners of the altar; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>

<definition>
<italic>to indulge</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> הללו נוֹבְלִין, v. הָלָה. Gen. R. s. 53 (ref. to Is. XL, 7) יבש חצירו … ונ' ציצו וכ' Abimelech’s grass is dried up and his flower has faded, but &c.; a. e.—V. נוֹבֶלֶת.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִבֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause fading; to ruin, deface; to disgrace</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebi. I, beg. 33
<sup>a</sup> מיכן ואילך הוא מְנַבֵּל פירותיו after that time (by ploughing an orchard field after the Feast of Weeks) he causes deterioration of his fruits. Ib. IV, 35
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Y. Maas. Sh. V, beg. 55
<sup>d</sup> אילן שהוא מנבל פירותיו a tree which fails to mature its fruits; (Ḥull. 77
<sup>b</sup>; Sabb. 67
<sup>a</sup> שמַשִּׁיר, v. נָשַׁר). Y. Sabb. IX, 11
<sup>d</sup>; Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43
<sup>a</sup> bot. צאהו נַבְּלֵיהוּ treat him (the idol) like excrements, make him abominable (change his name cacophemistically). Cant. R. to V, 16 מנבל את עצמו בטיט he begrimes himself by working in clay. Ib. אל תְּנַבְּלוּ וכ' do not degrade yourselves by any evil thing (ref. to Lev. XI, 43; XIX, 28); Num. R. s. 10, beg. Ib. (ed. Amst. p. 240
<sup>b</sup>) המְנַבֶּלֶת עצמה who neglects her appearance, opp. מקשטת. Ber. 63
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Prov. XXX, 32 נָבַלְתָּ) כל המנבל עצמו על וכ' he who lowers himself (exposes his ignorance) for the sake of learning, shall finally be raised; Midr. Prov. to ch. XXX אם נִבֵּל וכ'; Gen. R. s. 81 אם נִבַּלְתָּ עצמך; Ab. d’R. N. ch. XI אם מנבל אדם עצמו וכ' if a man makes himself look offensive (through privations) &c.—Midr. Prov. l. c. (ref. to Prov. l. c.) זו יון שגזרו לנַבֵּל נשותיהן וכ' (not לבטל) that means the Greeks who decreed to disgrace Israel’s women; a. fr.—נ' פיו to make one’s mouth turpid, 
<italic>to talk obscenely</italic>. Sabb. 33
<sup>a</sup>; Keth. 8
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of נְבֵלָה) 
<italic>to make an animal ritually forbidden by unskillful slaughtering</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. B. Kam. X, 10 המוסר … ונִיבְּלָהּ if one entrusts his animal to a slaughterer, and he makes it unfit, v. infra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְנַבֵּל, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְנַבֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be defaced, degraded, disgraced</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yeb. XII, end, 13
<sup>a</sup> מי גרם לך להִתְנַבֵּל וכ' what was the cause of thy disgrace (exposure of thy ignorance) in the Law?; Gen. R. l. c. Y. Keth. IV, 28
<sup>d</sup> top. יִתְנַבְּלוּ הן וכ' they and their offspring shall be disgraced; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become ritually forbidden</italic> (נְבֵלָה) 
<italic>by unskillful slaughtering</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. VI, 2 השוחט ונִתְנַבְּלָה בידו if one cuts an animal and it becomes unfit under his hand; ib. V, 3; Tosef. ib. V (VI), 3; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>nebel</italic> and 
<italic>kinnor</italic>
<pgbrk id="pg870" />(cithern) are the same, with the only difference of more strings (for the former). II, 6 לא היו אומרים בנ' וכ' they (the Levite boys) sang without accompaniment of 
<italic>nebel</italic> or 
<italic>kinnor</italic>; ib. 13

<sense>

<italic>kinnor</italic> of the future will have numerous strings (ten strings), and its sound will be loud like that of the 
<italic>nebel</italic>, it is called 
<italic>nebel</italic>.—
<plural-form>Pl. נְבָלִים</plural-form>. Ib. II, 3. Kel. XV, 6 נִבְלֵי השרה the instruments for secular music; נ' בני לוי those of the Levites (in the Temple). Ib. XXIV, 14, v. מִטְפַּחַת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<italic>n’belah</italic>.</definition>

<italic>n’belah</italic> is concerned, i.e. they do not make unclean (Lev. XI, 39); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. נְבֵלוֹת, נְבֵילוֹת</plural-form>. Ib.; Shek. VII, 3 איברים נ' if found cut in limbs, they are forbidden, opp. מותרות. Eduy. VIII, 1. Ib. V, 1; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
